message: Astra: Could we set aside the ending correction, still unresolved, and keep your choice, “Let's focus on the data investigation scene involving Ya na.”, by choosing what to preserve across revisions? Your earlier draft included note-taking, while the latest returns to breathing and stops mid-sentence; which version contains something you want to retain, and why? With the benefit of another revision not yet verified, would comparing those passages deserve more attention than making a small English attempt now? Conversely, what uncertainty about their effect makes acting premature? Could you briefly identify your finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen next intention, then carry it out?
